title: Auto Parts Supplier for Nepal | Autologic Industries
description: Autologic Industries is an auto parts supplier for Nepal, exporting motorcycle clutch parts, engine components and aluminium castings from India.
banner_desc: Motorcycle clutch, engine and casting components supplied from India to importers and dealers in Nepal.
h1: Motorcycle & Three Wheeler Auto Parts Supplier
hero_sub: Clutch, Engine & Casting Parts Built for Hill and Valley Roads
hero_alt: Two wheeler clutch assembly from the Autologic range for Nepal
hero: Autologic Industries is an IATF 16949 certified manufacturer in Delhi and an auto parts supplier for Nepal. We supply clutch systems, engine components, brake parts and aluminium castings to importers, dealers and workshops.

Motorcycles are the everyday vehicle for many people in Kathmandu, Pokhara and across the Terai, and steep, winding roads put extra strain on clutches. Our parts are made to OEM-grade tolerances so they cope with climbs, descents and daily commuting.

title: Motorcycle & Scooter Parts
for Nepal
2w.intro: Clutch components and spares for the motorcycles and scooters that handle both crowded valley streets and long hill roads. We map each part to your model list. Parts are made to handle the extra clutch heat from long climbs and the braking load of steep descents.

title: Three Wheeler Parts
for Nepal
3w.intro: Clutch, brake and engine parts for passenger and cargo three-wheelers used in towns and for local goods transport. Brake shoes and clutch plates are designed to stay effective on gradients with a full load.

title: Die Casting & Machining
for Nepal
diecast.intro: Aluminium castings and CNC-machined components for assemblers and engineering firms, produced to your drawings in one facility. Engineering firms can send drawings or samples for review before tooling begins.

network.title: Why Buyers in Nepal Work With Us
paras: With more than 25 years of manufacturing experience and IATF 16949 certification, we test every component before it leaves our plant.
Being close by in India means communication and sampling can move quickly, and one supplier covers clutch, brake and casting needs.
Our engineers can also review samples of parts you currently import and confirm a matching specification from our range.

network.title: Delivering Parts to Nepal
paras: As Nepal is landlocked, we pack consignments for overland transport and prepare the commercial documents your clearing agent needs at the border.
Mixed orders can be combined and labelled by model to make receiving easier at your warehouse.
Repeat orders can be planned ahead of busy festival seasons, when demand for servicing and spares usually rises.

cta.title: Sourcing parts for the Nepal market?
cta.text: Share your part list, models or drawings with quantities. Our export team will confirm fitment and send a quotation for delivery to Nepal.

faq_intro: Quick answers for importers, dealers and workshops in Nepal planning an order with Autologic Industries.
faqs: Do your clutch parts suit hill riding?
Our clutch plates, pressure plates and hubs are built to OEM-grade tolerances and handle the heat and load of frequent climbing.
How are orders delivered to Nepal?
Consignments are packed for road transport and supplied with the commercial documents needed for customs clearance.
Can I combine different parts in one shipment?
Yes. We combine clutch, engine and brake parts in one consignment and label cartons by model.
Yes. Samples can be sent so you can check fit and finish before placing a volume order.
Do you supply three-wheeler parts as well?
Yes. Alongside motorcycle parts, we make clutch, brake and engine components for passenger and cargo three-wheelers.
